"""Acceptance pairs measure rendered roles, independently of color derivation."""
import asyncio
import copy

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from crm.auth import Identity
from crm.config import Settings
from crm.main import create_app
from crm.seed import DEMO_ORG, DEMO_USER, create_demo_repository
from crm.services.brand_palette import SURFACES, contrast, derive, ramp
from crm.services.ui_context import resolve_branding


@pytest.mark.parametrize("seed", ["#506d48", "#0f172a", "#1a1f36", "#ffffff", "#000000", "#808080", "#ffff00", "#00ffff", "#7f8c3a", "#1abc9c", "#ff0000", "#0000ff"])
def test_brand_identity_exact_and_all_live_text_focus_button_pairs_readable(seed):
    palette = derive(seed)
    assert palette["brand"] == seed and ramp(seed)[6] == seed
    for theme, surfaces in SURFACES.items():
        tokens = palette[theme]
        for surface in surfaces:
            assert contrast(tokens["primary"], surface) >= 4.5, (seed, theme, "text")
            assert contrast(tokens["focus"], surface) >= 3, (seed, theme, "focus")
        for background in ("primary", "primary-hover"):
            assert contrast(tokens["on-primary"], tokens[background]) >= 4.5, (seed, theme, background)
        for name in ("success", "warning", "danger"):
            assert contrast(tokens[name], tokens[name+"-bg"]) >= 4.5, (seed, theme, name)
        assert all(len(color) == 7 and color.startswith("#") for color in tokens.values())


def test_cached_palette_does_not_share_mutable_data_and_invalid_css_cannot_escape():
    first = derive("#123456")
    first["dark"]["primary"] = "red;display:none"
    assert derive("#123456")["dark"]["primary"] != "red;display:none"
    assert derive("#fff;background:url(https://invalid)")["brand"] == "#ba352c"


def test_installation_rejection_is_persistent_safe_and_clears_after_fix_without_tenant_color_leak():
    async def exercise():
        repo = create_demo_repository()
        row = {"id": 1, "accent_hex": "invalid CSS", "fallback_at": None, "fallback_reason": None}
        repo.tables["platform_branding"] = [row]
        identity = Identity(DEMO_USER, DEMO_ORG, "admin")
        first = await resolve_branding(repo, Settings(), identity)
        assert first["accent_hex"] == "#b83d30"
        assert row["fallback_reason"] == "semente_invalida" and row["fallback_at"]
        assert len(repo.tables["api_audit_log"]) == 1
        await resolve_branding(repo, Settings(), identity)
        assert len(repo.tables["api_audit_log"]) == 1
        row["accent_hex"] = "#ffff00"
        await resolve_branding(repo, Settings(), identity)
        assert row["fallback_reason"] is None and row["fallback_at"] is None
        assert len(repo.tables["api_audit_log"]) == 2
        assert "#b83d30" not in str(repo.tables["api_audit_log"])
    asyncio.run(exercise())


def test_preview_requires_identity_and_does_not_save_unsaved_color():
    repo = create_demo_repository()
    app = create_app(Settings(environment="test", repository_backend="memory"), repo,
        lambda _: Identity(DEMO_USER, DEMO_ORG, "viewer"))
    before = copy.deepcopy(repo.tables)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = client.post("/api/v1/ui/branding/preview", json={"accent_hex": "#ffff00"})
        assert response.status_code == 200 and response.json()["data"]["brand"] == "#ffff00"
        assert client.post("/api/v1/ui/branding/preview", json={"accent_hex": "red;display:none"}).status_code == 422
    assert repo.tables == before
    with TestClient(create_app(Settings(environment="test", repository_backend="memory"), create_demo_repository())) as client:
        assert client.post("/api/v1/ui/branding/preview", json={"accent_hex": "#123456"}).status_code == 401

report.summary: 本次为PYTHON_CPU采样（10秒、99Hz、总权重988 samples、257节点），CPU样本权重集中在少数叶帧：rank1 symbol_9db888ac9b41 self 19.33%（total同值，无子调用）、rank2 symbol_db621560ea44 self 11.44%、rank3 symbol_1393bb56aa5f self 9.21%/total 28.54%、rank4 symbol_6125ef45be18 self 7.39%/total 18.83%。调用链显示rank1与rank2分别主要挂在rank3与rank4之下（rank3的多个出现位置以rank1为唯一返回的被调用者，权重9/17/2/1；rank2的出现位置挂在rank4下，权重8/8/5/3/1），提示“rank3→rank1”和“rank4→rank2”是两条主要自耗路径，但ancestors_truncated与occurrences_truncated均为true，上层业务入口（如品牌配色预览的渲染/序列化入口）未被完整返回，无法确认业务归属。所有symbol_hint为unknown，无法从词形判断是计算、序列化还是I/O；权重是采样权重，不等于请求延迟、CPU利用率或调用次数。E1.verification_available=false，因此未做compare_profiles，热点是否可重复尚未验证；E6仅为复测草案，未执行。用户要求的“绑定源码、生成优化补丁、运行原测试与多组CPU对照”超出本诊断能力（无源码/符号映射、不能执行命令），需在平台侧完成。

hypotheses.claim: rank3 symbol_1393bb56aa5f 的包含权重主要来自其叶帧子调用 rank1 symbol_9db888ac9b41（self 19.33%），即该路径是本次采样中最大的单一自耗集中点；若成立，优化应针对rank1内部计算而非rank3自身逻辑（rank3 self仅9.21%）。
hypotheses.verification: 按E6草案（同目标、10秒、99Hz）复测，并用compare_profiles比较rank1/rank3的self与total百分比差异；同时记录业务P95/P99、吞吐、错误率与采集开销。判定标准（待协商示例）：rank1 self占比在两次采集中排序保持前2且差异不超过5个百分点，且rank3→rank1的父子关系仍存在，则视为可重复热点；随后在受控分支上对rank1内部做单点改动，用相同采集参数与功能测试对照，观察rank1 self占比与业务指标是否同向变化。

hypotheses.claim: rank4 symbol_6125ef45be18（self 7.39%/total 18.83%）下的rank2 symbol_db621560ea44（self 11.44%）构成第二条独立自耗路径，与rank3→rank1路径并列，说明CPU开销分散在至少两条调用路径上，而非单一热点。
hypotheses.verification: 复测后比较rank2与rank4的self/total百分比及各自出现位置数量；若两条路径在复测中均保持在前4且父子关系稳定，则确认开销分散。进一步在受控实验中分别屏蔽/替换其中一条路径的实现，用相同10秒99Hz采集与功能回归对照，检查对应self占比下降是否伴随另一路径占比上升（迁移）或整体下降（真实节省）。

hypotheses.claim: 当前证据不足以把热点归因到“品牌配色预览”业务逻辑：调用链上层上下文被截断（ancestors_truncated=true），且symbol_hint全为unknown，无法确认rank1–rank4是否位于配色计算、颜色序列化或渲染输出路径中。
